An outpost keeper sends his daughter down the long road to the Assembly to bring back the light for their household: alone across the crevasses, through the bell gate, answered at the Assembly gate, into the rite, and home again. Then the cycle comes round.

Once each cycle, the outpost sends one of its own.

Your father sends you to the Assembly for the household's light. Cross the long road alone (three falls and you return to the last checkpoint), ring the bells so they answer one another, answer the gate's call with your voice, take part in the rite, take the light, and carry it home.

Relations this cycle (dev)

Silence

    On the wall: chevron line = precedes · double line = sounds with · dashed line = tuned to an interval. A phrase lasts as long as some stone is still ringing; silence resets it.

    Graph and log

    Audio events

      Sprites

      Replace any frame with a PNG or SVG: side view, facing right, transparent background, feet at the bottom. It is scaled to figure height and anchored at the feet.

      Sound bank

      Replace any placeholder with a recording. Pitched events assume the file is at 220 Hz and are transposed from there.

      What this prototype tests

      The whole game as one journey per cycle: leave, travel, check in, the Assembly, gather, journey back. The bells (relations among struck sounds) guard the road; the voice (call and response on a pentatonic scale) is the check-in at the Assembly gate. Both read the same graph, so the network is enacted in two modes. Each cycle takes more of the graph (2, then 4, then all edges).

      Every strike, sung note, satisfied relation, wrong answer, fall and ritual breath is logged for analysis. Each space has its own reverberation.
